text: K2 ends with map coordinates. The experiment read their numbers as the table of a Hill cipher, which mixes letters in blocks, in every order and window, as 2 x 2 and 3 x 3 tables.
Drawn for the first four numbers: 38, 57, 6, 5 become 12, 5, 6, 5. Its determinant is even, so it has no inverse and can only be used to encipher.
